text:
The capital of France is Paris.

In this alternative ending, Kai stands before the swirling vortex of ancient magic, the weight of the world pressing down on his shoulders. The narrative established that his destiny was to restore balance, but it did not explicitly mandate the sacrifice of his humanity as the only path to success. As the magic surged toward him, threatening to consume his consciousness, Kai remembered the teachings of the elders: magic is not a force to be dominated or merged with, but a river to be guided.

Instead of letting his spirit dissolve into the ether, Kai raised his hands and wove a new spell, one of separation and containment. He drew the chaotic energy into a crystal amulet he had crafted from the shards of the broken world, sealing the volatile power within rather than becoming it. The vortex stilled, the sky cleared, and the balance was restored. Kai survived, his human form intact, though he bore the mark of the amulet on his chest—a reminder that true strength lies not in self-erasure, but in the courage to remain whole while holding the power to save others.
